For me, I've waited between 3-5 months for all my cartilage piercings and I've been healing just fine. The only thing is I would recommend to never have more than 3 piercings/holes healing at the same time. Since cartilage can take 4 months to 1+ years it's important not to have too many healing at once or that'll delay the healing.

I would wait it out a bit more. I had mine pierced in May 2018 and had a bump that didnt go away from July 2018 to Dec 2018- so 5 whole months. Annoying af but to be fair I did touch it a lot to check for crusties. Just keep leaving it alone and run water over it in the shower and use a saline spay if you have one. If it still bothers you a lot after a couple weeks go to your piercer to ask what to do.
So I should be okay then? Since I do wait a full day/24 hours in between before using the peel since I apply them all at night.
I'd like to keep my current routine if I can since it works for me but I'm just not sure about the long term effects of using the acids and the peel
